title: Tilt, flip and push layers in depth from the canvas and the panel
goal: With the 2.5D model in place, a person can grab a layer and tilt it in 3D right on the canvas, set exact angles and depth in the panel, key them over time, and set up the camera, all as the approved mocks show.
notes: User's words (2026-10-11): "I'm curious how difficult it would be to add 3d manipulation for text, objects, etc. Allowing us to create 3d animations and transitions which feel very native, rather than only focusing on 2d orientation of transitions" then, after the 2.5D vs true 3D answer: "let's try 2.5d then and maybe do that before title updates, so we can use it for the title updates". Scope is 2.5D: flat layers (text, pictures, shapes, groups, video clips) rotating about X and Y and moving in depth under a perspective camera, like Keynote and Apple Motion. NOT extruded 3D text, lighting, materials or 3D models. Four tasks in order: 2.5D design (mocks + card), 2.5D model and renderer, 2.5D controls on the canvas and in the panel, 3D transitions and title entrances. The title rework tasks (title-backgrounds-that-are-alive-auroras-energy, title-text-visibly-comes-in-and-every-built-in-t) are sequenced after these and should use the 3D moves. This is step 3 of 4.
acceptance: Built to the approved mocks from 'Design how layers turn and move in depth (2.5D), as mocks' (mocks are the floor: match them, never rewrite them to fit the code); if the card is unanswered, build the recommended option and say so in the log
On-canvas 3D rotate handle that tilts about X and Y live with a readout, Shift snapping to 15 degree steps, and a way to reset; depth adjustable by drag or scroll with a modifier as the mocks say
Panel rows Rotation X, Rotation Y, Depth and Perspective with key diamonds, Mixed for several picked layers, and keyboard nudges
Camera controls as designed, with a View menu row to reset the camera
Undo is one step per drag; the controls never take over plain 2D editing (a layer with no tilt behaves exactly as today)
Works for text, shapes, pictures, groups, components and video clips at Next defaults
A walk tilts a text layer 40 degrees on Y, keys a flip over 1 s, scrubs, and photographs frames; and checks plain 2D rotate and move are unchanged
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Handle design card opened by the 2.5D design task: tilt-flip-and-push-layers-in-depth-from-the-canv-how-do-you-turn-a-layer-toward-o (recommended A, arcs on the turn knob). Mocks: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-depth.html. Build A if unanswered.

From the design audit: give the knob arcs a generous hit area and a pointer cue; check Option Command ] / [ (Bring Nearer / Send Further in the mock) against Premiere before shipping them; the opened property rows under a title on the timeline are drawn on video-depth.html only, follow the video timeline's existing design for how a track opens.

From the model task: the four 3D values are MotionProperty .rotationX/.rotationY/.depth/.pivotDepth, already in Layer.keyableProperties (picker group '3D', which lists after Effects today; the mock wants its own panel section after Position & Size). Camera keys are SceneCamera.motions with .cameraPerspective/.cameraDepth/.cameraX/.cameraY on the document clock; no UI sets them yet. For handles and readouts use PhotonzDocument.drawnMap(of:) (one plane map from the layer's upright box to the screen) and drawnQuad(of:); CanvasDisplay already maps the outline and frame handles through it. Groups: GroupContent.keeps3D (Motion's 3D group) exists in the model with no control. Design note: docs/design/space-3d.md.
decision "How do you turn a layer toward or away from you on the canvas?" resolved: Arcs on the turn knob
Both cards unanswered, so built the recommended options: A for the handle (arcs on the knob) and A for the camera (a setting of the frame).

Adversarial review before building: a depth arrow on every pick would clutter redlining (the main use) and take presses near the middle of small layers, so the arrow shows only once the knob is hovered or the layer is turned; the 3D section shows in documents with time, or on a still only once something is turned. The mock's arc hit areas overlap the knob centre (its SVG would swing on a knob press); here the knob keeps a 7pt middle. ⌥⌘]/[ are free in the app and unused in Premiere and Photoshop.

Built: core SpaceEditing.swift (SpaceHandles, SpaceDrag, set/push/reset 3D values, camera keys) + 17 tests; canvas CanvasSpaceHandles.swift; panel Space3DInspector.swift (3D + Camera sections); EditorState+Space3D.swift; Layer menu, right click, View menu rows; flag next-turn-in-depth on in Next; walk step spaceHandle (real pointer events on the arcs).
